sentences.text:
Through the instant petition, prayer is made for protection of life and liberty of the present
petitioner and for restraining the official respondents to proceed further in Fir No.189, dated
02.09.2017, under Sections 420, 465, 468, 478 and 120-B of the Ipc, registered at Police Station
Gobindgarh Mandi, District Fatehgarh Sahib.

2.  At the very outset, learned State counsel, on instructions from the police official concerned,
submits that the matter has been thoroughly investigated, and thereupon, a cancellation report has been prepared after approval of the competent authority, and same has been filed before the learned Illaqa Magistrate concerned on dated 08.06.2024, and the now the same is pending consideration before the latter concerned.
